forensic_findings.title: All 11 `nvthanh2004` + 5 `tundng111` (16 total) notebooks pulled with 100% HTTP 200; A0-A6, B1 Control, C3, C0 & V8S match raw Kaggle artifacts.
forensic_findings.detail: Direct 1-to-1 verification against Kaggle `run_manifest.json`, `evaluation.json`, `initialization_check.json`, `results.csv`, `test_evaluation/summary.csv`, `A6_*_per_class.json`, `execution_log.txt`, and `B1/B2/C3/C0/V8S` `metrics.json` confirms exact agreement across A0-A6, B1 Control, `C3` (57.283±0.173%), `C0` (58.812±0.082%), and `V8S` (61.414±0.074%) (1 honest precision/SD-convention mismatch flagged on B2 V8F).

forensic_findings.title: Precision resolution gap in `01_KET_QUA_A1_A6.md`: Test CSV stores full precision (`A1_V8 = 88.7328%` vs `A3_V8 = 88.7305%`), whereas `.md` only showed 1 decimal (`88.7%` tie).
forensic_findings.detail: `01_KET_QUA_A1_A6.md` Section 5.2 noted that `A1` and `A3` tied at `88.7%` and could not be ranked without full floats; pulling `test_evaluation/summary.csv` from Kaggle recovers exact floats: `A1 YOLOv8s mAP50 = 88.7328%`, `A3 YOLOv8s mAP50 = 88.7305%` (A1 strictly higher by +0.0024 pp), and `A6 YOLO11s = 88.9379%` / `58.0825%`, `A6 YOLOv8s = 88.3692%` / `57.3711%`.

forensic_findings.title: Dataset manifest fingerprint nuance between Thanh's A0-A6 (`ce2a883e...`) and Dung's B2 (`026a2afb...`) is real and confirmed in manifests.
forensic_findings.detail: Inspecting `V8F-3407/run_manifest.json` -> `inputs.manifest_sha256` directly confirms `026a2afb617254b9dd2b9461651bce6f74295d18f29d52a790bf755d32944f65`, matching `BASELINE_AUDIT_B1_B2_REVIEW3.md` and Chapter IV's Provenance Note.

forensic_findings.title: A1 is legitimately #1 on GDUT mAP; A6 does NOT beat A1 on GDUT single-seed (already reported honestly, NOT inflated).
forensic_findings.detail: Raw `summary.csv` proves `A1_yolo11s` reaches `89.7616% mAP50 / 59.0804% mAP50-95` vs `A6_yolo11s` `88.9379% / 58.0825%`. `gdut-final-test-evaluation` `final_test()` also ran unfused (`switch_to_deploy_in_final_test=False`), explaining `9.2 ms` vs `7.5 ms` T4 latency (Cell 8 `preflight.py` unit test calls `switch_to_deploy()` only on synthetic tensors); post-fusion RTX 3050 equivalence (`-300,992` params, max diff `7.93e-4`, `-3.6%` Strict FP32 / `-6.3%` AMP latency) was measured locally on `GDUT_A6_YOLO11s_best.pt`.

forensic_findings.title: Stage 2 `args.yaml` augmentation asymmetry (`mixup=0.1` in A1 vs `0.0` in A2..A6) verified verbatim in Kaggle outputs.
forensic_findings.detail: Verified directly inside Kaggle `args.yaml` files: `A1` uses `mixup=0.1, hsv_v=0.45`, while `A2..A6` use `mixup=0.0, hsv_v=0.40` (with `hsv_h=0.0, hsv_s=0.0` locked across all runs).

forensic_findings.title: B2 5-Seed V8F precision rounding (`90.25%` vs exact `90.2447%` -> `90.24%`) & `pstdev (ddof=0)` vs `sample stdev (ddof=1)`.
forensic_findings.detail: `BASELINE_AUDIT_B1_B2_REVIEW3.md` / `ch6_results.tex` list `V8F` 5-seed as `P=90.25±0.94, R=86.47±0.58, mAP50=91.82±0.17, mAP50-95=60.781±0.353`. Recomputing from the 5 Kaggle `metrics.json` files gives `mean P = 90.2447%` (rounds to `90.24%`, -0.0053 pp vs `90.25%`), and the reported `±0.94/±0.58/±0.17/±0.353` corresponds to population `pstdev (ddof=0)`; standard sample SD (`ddof=1`, n=5) is `±1.05/±0.65/±0.19/±0.394`.
